title: The kite festival
paragraphs: Every August, the village held a kite festival on the hill. This year Reza had built a {{1}} kite shaped like a fish, with a tail almost three metres long. On the morning of the contest, there was very {{2}} wind, and most kites stayed on the ground. Reza waited {{3}} for a change in the weather.

Just after noon, a light {{4}} began to blow from the sea. He ran down the hill, and the kite rose {{5}} into the sky. The crowd {{6}} and pointed.
